title: Gus and the Four Orange Cones
synopsis: Dan delivers a surprisingly small box of nested orange cones to the garage, and Gus tries to understand how four large-looking objects can fit together.
continuity_state: Before: Dan the donkey has established a parcel shed near Red Door Garage and a blue enclosed box truck. The first stop on his route is the garage. After: Ms. Pam receives four nested orange traffic cones for marking her garage work area, stores them in the yard shed, and thanks Dan for the first delivery. Jack draws four cones, then one stack, on the same Season Five notebook page.
